title: Hobeika 2019 social PPS — collaboration
citation: Hobeika, L., Taffou, M., Carpentier, T., & Viaud-Delmon, I. (2019). Social coding of the multisensory space around us. Royal Society Open Science 6, 181878.
notes: Source-backed sample schedule. Generated audio, calibrated tactile delivery and original response acquisition affect replication fidelity.

reference_parameters.source_scope: One participant’s collaboration experiment session with both isolated and dyad conditions.
reference_parameters.sound_source: Bubbling-water recording binaurally rendered with nonindividual LISTEN HRTFs.
reference_parameters.baseline_sound_policy: The sound still plays in both endpoint control trial types. The target is timed during the pre-sound or post-sound silence.
reference_parameters.response: Speeded button press with the right index finger on detection of the target. Withhold on auditory-only catches.

preview_substitutions.audio: Generated pink noise rendered on the reported paths with the Toolkit binaural engine. Exact original waveform and spatial-render settings are unavailable.
preview_substitutions.timing: Two repeats per cell in each of five blocks yield ten repeats per context and side–delay cell. The preview uses a fixed 3000 ms after sound offset and equal catch allocation by side. The exact reported jitter sampling and realized within-block composition are unknown.
preview_substitutions.response: Mouse press proxy. Calibrated physical tactile delivery and response capture require separate verification.

implementation_gaps: Exact bubbling-water source waveform, LISTEN HRTF identity and calibrated headphone transfer are unavailable.
The preview synthesizes the specified 20 ms, 250 Hz sine at a digital default amplitude. Physical tactile delivery and response capture require calibration.
Exact post-sound jitter sampling, catch split by sound side and realized trial order are unreported.

The social trial scheduler does not coordinate a second instrumented participant, synchronize two systems, or capture both responses. The audience manipulation also requires an operator and a separate participant.

dyad_design.seating: Fixed seat with same-gender partner seated alongside at 1 m in the dyad session. Leave the chair empty in the isolated session.
dyad_design.instruction: Both participants are asked to work as a team and told their joint performance is recorded.
dyad_design.order: Counterbalance isolated and dyad context across participants.
dyad_design.preview_operator_action: The Toolkit stages two groups of five blocks and counterbalances their order. The operator changes the social context. Exact original block-to-context allocation is unreported.

provenance.source: Royal Society Open Science 6, 181878, §§2.1–2.4 and Fig. 1, pp. 3–5.

provenance.field: Toolkit auditory proxy, jitter and allocation defaults
provenance.source: PPS Kit configuration. A fixed 3000 ms interval and uniform within-block allocation are preview defaults.
